description.en: Dashboard for a revenue-based-financing fund or private-credit book of many small SME contracts: portfolio health, AUM, repayment progress, industry and city concentration risk, and a watchlist of contracts with declining revenue.
description.zh-CN: 面向收入分成融资（RBF）基金或由大量小微企业合同组成的私募信贷组合的看板：组合健康度、管理规模、还款进度、行业与城市集中度风险，以及收入下滑合同的观察名单。

agentPrompts: Summarize the latest Contracts and flag what needs my attention.
Which contracts need attention this week, and why are they on the watchlist?
